scripts.validate: bun run validate:changesets && bun run verify:lockfile && bun run format:check && bun run verify:boundaries && bun run verify:extension-api-version && bun run verify:translations && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.test: lerna run test --ignore e2e && bun run --cwd packages/e2e test
scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name dist -o -name .cache -o -name storybook-static \) -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && rm -rf .nx
scripts.reset: bun run clean && bun install && bun run build
scripts.dev: PSTDIO_DISABLE_EMBED_MANIFEST=${PSTDIO_DISABLE_EMBED_MANIFEST:-1} PSTDIO_DEFAULT_EXTENSIONS=${PSTDIO_DEFAULT_EXTENSIONS:-'["harness-claude-code","harness-codex","harness-open-code","pstdio-base-themes","pstdio-planner","pstdio-reports","pstdio-skills","extension-lab"]'} PSTDIO_HOME=${PSTDIO_HOME:-$HOME/.pstdio-dev} PSTDIO_API_URL=${PSTDIO_API_URL:-http://localhost:19841} PSTDIO_TERMINAL_ORIGINS=${PSTDIO_TERMINAL_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:5173} PSTDIO_DISABLE_API_AUTO_START=${PSTDIO_DISABLE_API_AUTO_START:-1} bun packages/pstdio/src/index.ts -- serve --host localhost --port 19841 & PSTDIO_API_URL=${PSTDIO_API_URL:-http://localhost:19841} bun run --cwd packages/pstdio-dashboard dev -- --host localhost --port 5173 & wait
